summary: Credit Acceptance Corp filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026 disclosing amendments to two Wells Fargo-administered financing facilities, not a special situation. Amendment No. 4 extended the $500.0 million Term ABS 2019-2 revolving period from September 15, 2026 to September 15, 2028 while raising the rate from 5.43% to 5.83%. A parallel amendment extended Warehouse Facility II's amortization date to September 15, 2028 and cut pricing to SOFR plus 175 basis points from plus 185, with $180.0 million outstanding. No equity, ownership, or control terms changed.
